title: Social Memory cuing
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from participants performing a visual working memory task presented in virtual reality. Participants viewed objects (bowl, cup, plate, teapot) with varying status and were cued by either an avatar or stick figure pointing left or right. Memory was probed for both item location and status, with cues being either congruent or incongruent with target locations. The dataset includes raw EEG data, processed derivatives, behavioral measures, and comprehensive event coding for analysis of neural correlates of socially and non-socially cued working memory.
methods_description: Participants wore a head-mounted display to complete a visual working memory task in virtual reality. EEG was recorded during the task, which involved presentation of memory targets, maintenance intervals, and probe trials with location and status questions. Detailed event codes mark task phases including cue presentation, target onset, maintenance intervals, and response periods.
